_readme: MLStation ad manager. Add, pause or remove ads here, then run ./publish.sh. Per slot: active sponsor first, then Google AdSense (if enabled), then house ads. Never add a company's name or logo until it has agreed to advertise.

ads.text: Put your product in front of ML, AI and data practitioners. Clean, clearly labelled placements.
